concept.hr: Fiksni pojasni filtar propušta jedan bočni pojas; kvarc oscilatora bira koji
concept.en: A fixed bandpass filter keeps one sideband; the oscillator's crystal picks which

summary.hr: Balansni mješač daje oba bočna pojasa, a filtar na 9000 kHz ± 1,5 kHz zadrži jedan. Preklopka kvarca (9001,5 ili 8998,5 kHz) bira LSB ili USB.
summary.en: A balanced mixer gives both sidebands and a filter at 9000 kHz ± 1.5 kHz keeps one. The crystal switch (9001.5 or 8998.5 kHz) picks LSB or USB.

what.hr: Aplet applet_dsp_filter.html (LSB i USB filtarskom metodom) i njegove slike 831, 832, 940 i 941 (blok-dijagram s frekvencijama i spektri), te tekst o SSB modulatoru (50ohm.de, odjeljak modulatoren, hrvatski prijevod)
what.en: The applet applet_dsp_filter.html (LSB and USB by the filter method) and its figures 831, 832, 940 and 941 (the block diagram with its frequencies and the spectra), and the text on the SSB modulator (50ohm.de, section modulatoren, Croatian translation)

credits.by: 50ohm.de-Autorenteam, AJW-Referat des DARC e.V. (figures: Prof. Dr. Matthias Jung, DL9MJ)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu, četiri slike ponovno nacrtane kao jedan blok-dijagram i dva spektra izračunana iz modela, preveden na engleski, dodani ispitni ton, razmak do ruba filtra i predlošci
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit, the four figures redrawn as one block diagram and two spectra calculated from a model, translated into English, a test tone, the gap to the filter edge and presets added
